title: Though
html_source: An example of what Hugh Kenner calls The Uncle Charles Principle(the narrative idiom need not be the narrator’s). The syntax is not quite right – though could be an and or a but better conjoining the purity and female sexual allure (Kenner, H. Joyce’s Voices, p18).
